Shopping and Orders

How do I place an order?

Browse our collection, select your fragrance, add it to your bag, and proceed to checkout. We accept online payment via Razorpay and Cash on Delivery.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking through Razorpay, and Cash on Delivery across India.

Shipping and Delivery

Do you offer free shipping?

Yes, we offer complimentary shipping on all orders across India.

How long does delivery take?

Orders are dispatched within 1-3 business days. Delivery typically takes 3-7 business days depending on your location.

Fragrance Education

What is Extrait de Parfum?

Extrait de Parfum is the highest concentration of fragrance oil, typically 20-30%. It offers the richest, longest-lasting scent experience.
